extracted.name: Sour Milk Spice Cake
extracted.description: This is a cake my Mother made in the 30's and 40's. Note: To make sour milk combine l cup milk and l tablespoon vinegar. Let sit for l5 minutes.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x9 inch baking pan.
Combine and sift sugar, flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and cloves. Make a well in the center and pour in the milk and oil. Mix until combined, then add nuts.
Pour into a 9x9 inch pan and bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 45 minutes.
